svg.title: Ila rejects a contractor's request to protect the model property first.
svg.desc: A contractor's hand points towards dry model-building windows, but Ila looks towards residents moving through water on the other side. She refuses a private promise and insists that the reason be recorded immediately.
svg.text: Page 49, panel 2 · Tight view on Ila receiving a contractor's silent appeal

text.tspan: The contractor asks Ila to protect the showcase

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
